allowed_scope: Record the exact committed revision under test (git rev-parse HEAD) in the new evidence record so the acceptance is bound to bytes, not to a date.

Regenerate the generated surfaces with scripts/status_render.py and verify with scripts/status_verify.py, keeping the required 'Scheduled orchestrator cutover' and 'NOT COMPLETE / BLOCKED' style markers truthful rather than deleting them to force a pass.

Run the focused Career suites and scripts/tests/test_status_consistency.py with explicit progress output and bounded timeouts.
Commit and push only the reconciliation, tests and truthful evidence attributable to this task.
stop_conditions: Do not register, enable, disable, replace or trigger the real ChiefCareerScan-* / ChiefCareerBrief scheduled tasks; a read-only status query is allowed. The four region tasks are already registered and enabled by an earlier task and run read-only dry runs, so no schedule change is needed for this lane.
Do not use a local interactive browser/GUI, Edge, a signed-in session, cookies or the owner browser profile.
Do not claim a source is live, empty or validated without direct evidence; preserve UNKNOWN/unavailable distinctions.
Do not write a canonical tracker workbook, apply a manifest, submit an application, contact an employer, mutate LinkedIn or log in to any account.
Do not mark the cutover COMPLETE merely to clear the status warning; if the live acceptance cannot be run on the committed revision, keep that gap explicit.

Do not run long commands that produce no output: previous attempts of this lane died to a 300s no-progress watchdog. Stream progress (background run plus periodic polling) instead of redirecting a multi-minute suite to a file silently.
